Battle Brother.Chapter demeanour: Disciplined: the Codex has an answer
Battle Brother.Past event: Held the breach at Calth's sister moon for nine days
Battle Brother.Power armour history: The left greave hums a low litany when the bolter is drawn
Battle Brother.Description: Tall even for his kind, scar across the brow, blue pauldron beside the Watch's black

Skills.Specialities: Common Lore (Adeptus Astartes, Deathwatch, Imperium, War); Forbidden Lore (Xenos); Scholastic Lore (Codex Astartes); Speak Language (High and Low Gothic); Tactics (Assault Doctrine)

Modes.Chapter Solo Mode ability: Ultramarines: Favoured of the Primarch, reroll one failed test a session in the name of Guilliman
Modes.Speciality Solo Mode abilities: Bolter Mastery: +10 to hit with a bolter, more damage at higher Rank

Renown.Honours: Purity seal for the purge of Hive Aurelius

Traits.Name: Astartes physiology
Traits.Description: Unnatural Strength and Toughness (x2), sleep in the waking mind, the Omophagea.

Traits.Name: Hulking
Traits.Description: In power armour, foes gain +10 to hit.

Mental state.Critical injuries: Bionic left eye after a genestealer's claw

Notes.Background: Brother Cassian of the Ultramarines Fourth Company, sworn to the Long Vigil at Watch Fortress Erioch. He leads by the Codex and expects his kill-team to follow it, though a season among the Watch has taught him that the xenos have not read it.
